chunk_text: Dhooma is in Exaltation in Leo, Debilitation in Aquarius, and its Swakshetra (own sign) is Capricorn.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Vyatipata is in Exaltation in Scorpio, Debilitation in Taurus, and its Swakshetra (own sign) is Gemini.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Parivesha is in Exaltation in Gemini, Debilitation in Sagittarius, and its Swakshetra (own sign) is Sagittarius.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Indrachapa is in Exaltation in Sagittarius, Debilitation in Gemini, and its Swakshetra (own sign) is Cancer.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Upaketu is in Exaltation in Aquarius, Debilitation in Leo, and its Swakshetra (own sign) is Cancer.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Gulika, son of Saturn, has Aquarius as own house. Saturn has given his Moolatrikona to his son Gulika.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Jupiter's son, Yamaghantaka, has Sagittarius as its own house.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Ardhaprahara, Mercury's son, is in own sign if in Gemini.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Kala, son of the Sun, has Capricorn as its own house, a sign of his brother Saturn.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: Mrityu, son of Mars has Scorpio as own house.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: The degree ascending at the time of start of Gulika's portion will be the longitude of Gulika at a given place. Based on this longitude only, Gulika's effects for a particular nativity be estimated.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: To calculate Pranapada, convert the given time into vighatikas and divide by 15. The resultant Rasi and degrees are added to the Sun's longitude. If the Sun is in a fixed sign, add an additional 240 degrees. If the Sun is in a dual sign, add an additional 120 degrees.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: The birth will be auspicious if Pranapada falls in the 2nd, 5th, 9th, 4th, 10th or 11th from the natal ascendant.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)

chunk_text: In other houses, Pranapada indicates an inauspicious birth.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 5)
